observed_phase_hints.interpretation: Automatic 2D event/contact hypotheses; not manual pitch labels or contact probabilities

anchor_policy: fixed rear/lead forefoot midpoint XZ during observed stance, with fitted transition; explicit tail release
coordinate_system: clip-fixed inferred support frame; model-estimated meters; y normal to inferred local floor
limitations: Uncalibrated WHAM-initialized monocular SMPL fit. Constant within-clip shape; assumed local support, including follow-through. Genuine airborne motion, camera cuts and ambiguous depth require review. No measured player height or stride ground truth; no OpenSim IK.

phase_hints.interpretation: Automatic 2D event/contact hypotheses; not manual pitch labels or contact probabilities
phase_hints.stride_validation: Uncalibrated depth; not a measured stride

screening.interpretation: Screening only; passing does not validate 3D accuracy, depth, player height or stride. Support is a modeling constraint, not independent evidence. Plant separation below 0.8 modeled leg lengths triggers conservative depth review; it is not a universal pitching limit. Exact forefoot stance is imposed, not observed 3D contact. Anchor and camera initialization sensitivity can veto publication.

publication_screening.interpretation: Conservative review only. Fast wrist motion is an image-space proxy, not measured ball release. Approximate home direction is away from the broadcast camera; uncertain preparation, phase order or mostly lateral stride is withheld.
publication_screening.stride_proxy_definition: screening.phase_hints.stride_at_plant_leg is native interankle spacing at inferred plant divided by modeled leg length, not a measured rubber-to-landing stride
publication_screening.stance_anchor_separation_semantics: Fitted rear/lead forefoot-anchor separation; model scale and support assumptions, not measured stride

manual_visual_review.reason: Sampled leg lift, landing and follow-through broadly correspond; depth and stride unvalidated.
manual_visual_review.scope: Codex comparison of sampled source and fixed-scene skeleton frames; not a complete manual event annotation or measured 3D validation
manual_visual_review.reviewer: Codex visual inspection; no external 3D ground truth
